This guide is an overview of resources to help you and your team get started with DonorDock.

DonorDock + Zapier Overview
Your DonorDock account has the ability to connect with Zapier, a tool that links thousands of cloud apps and services.
kb/guide/en/households-and-when-to-use-t:
Households and When to Use Them in DonorDock
Households are one way to manage relationships in DonorDock. This article answers frequently asked questions about households and relationship management.
kb/guide/en/payment-amount-fields-explai:
Payment Amount Fields Explained
There are 5 gift amount fields that may be tracked in DonorDock for a gift. If not applicable, fields may be left blank: Base Gift Amount Recurring Gift Amount Gift Amount Override Amount Discrepancy
kb/guide/en/what-are-interactions-6r5WqX:
What are Interactions?
Interactions are donor touches that you log in DonorDock. An interaction can be assigned to a contact or a household. If you log an interaction at the household level, it is available to all household members.
kb/guide/en/data-retention-policy-a55hVN:
Data Retention Policy
DonorDock’s Data Retention Policy describes how long your data is retained in DonorDock and the terms under which the data can be deleted or exported. There is no automatic data deletion in DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/phone-number-field-explainer:
Phone Number Field Explainer
A contact in DonorDock can have up to 4 phone numbers assigned.
kb/guide/en/contact-roles-and-how-to-use:
Contact Roles and How to Use Them
Contact Roles are labels that help identify a contact’s function within a household. It’s important to properly identify contact roles to help with analysis and reporting.
kb/guide/en/create-a-gift-with-soft-cred:
Create a Gift with Soft Credits
Soft credits are a way to acknowledge an individual’s influence on a gift, even when they are not the primary donor of that gift. Soft credits allow you to track contributions to a gift made by multiple people.
kb/guide/en/custom-field-and-custom-fiel:
Custom Field and Custom Field Values
Custom Fields are used to store custom contact data and custom donor information. Custom Fields allow flexible management of contact information that can’t be captured by built-in contact fields.
kb/guide/en/create-a-gift-3dgvQfWl5z/Ste:
Create a Gift
You can create a gift for a contact manually in DonorDock. Once a gift is created, you can begin adding more information like soft credits, designations, and other gift details that are important to your organization.
kb/guide/en/setup-overview-dMUSGrWe5M/St:
DonorDock Setup Overview
This guide is an overview of resources to help you and your team get started with DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/recurring-gifts-kJZjHrM0ba/S:
Recurring Gifts
A recurring gift is a gift that a donor has committed to giving on a regular schedule (e.g., monthly, quarterly, or annually). DonorDock allows you to create recurring gifts and monitor the status of active recurring gifts.
kb/guide/en/contact-matching-what-is-it-:
Contact Matching: What is it and How Does it Work?
DonorDock includes a contact matching algorithm that is used during the import process to match imported data to existing contacts in your DonorDock instance. Learn more about how contact matching works.
kb/guide/en/create-a-new-designation-ZAZ:
Create a New Designation
Designations help organize gifts into meaningful categories that your organization cares about. When creating gifts in DonorDock, donors’ gifts must be assigned to a designation.
kb/guide/en/campaign-tracking-Fq5zVuANRe:
Campaign Tracking
Tracking campaigns in DonorDock allows you to attribute gifts to specific fundraising initiatives. Creating campaigns helps your organization understand which initiatives are driving the most revenue.
kb/guide/en/list-imports-and-when-to-use:
List Imports and When to Use Them
List imports allow you to bulk import contact data into DonorDock. You can use a list import when you want to bring in many contacts at once.
kb/guide/en/import-overview-cK5fXRXGP0/S:
Import Overview
DonorDock allows you to import contact data from a variety of sources. In this section, we’ll cover the different types of imports that you can use.
kb/guide/en/export-contact-data-ioL1IBZ3:
Export Contact Data
DonorDock allows you to export contact data in a number of different formats.
kb/guide/en/deactivate-a-contact-oQKS6Fh:
Deactivate a Contact
You can deactivate a contact in DonorDock if they’re no longer an active donor or a prospect. Deactivating a contact does not delete it from DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/create-a-contact-Mk3GYQHKWL/:
Create a Contact
You can create a contact in DonorDock manually. Contacts can be individuals or organizations.
kb/guide/en/what-is-import-deduplication:
What is Import Deduplication?
Import deduplication is part of DonorDock’s contact matching algorithm. It ensures that no duplicate records are created during the import process.
kb/guide/en/api-guides-basic-requests-K1:
API Guides: Basic Requests
This guide explains the different HTTP methods that are used in DonorDock’s API. This guide is designed for developers who have some programming experience.
kb/guide/en/setting-up-donor-prospect-se:
Setting Up Donor & Prospect Segments
Segments help you organize contacts into groups based on giving patterns and other donor characteristics. DonorDock provides several built-in segments for donor, prospect, major donor, and lapsed donor segments.
kb/guide/en/manage-segment-settings-a8Cp:
Manage Segment Settings
You can edit built-in and custom segments in DonorDock. Built-in segments have read-only rules but you can change the timing settings for these segments.
kb/guide/en/custom-field-reporting-8JAJR:
Custom Field Reporting
Using custom fields in DonorDock allows you to report on donor information that may not be available in standard fields. This gives your organization the ability to track and report on relevant donor information.
kb/guide/en/soft-credit-reporting-Q1CcE0:
Soft Credit Reporting
Soft credits allow you to acknowledge different contributors to a gift. You can use DonorDock’s reporting features to view and analyze soft credit data.
kb/guide/en/create-a-custom-report-1HPwL:
Create a Custom Report
DonorDock allows you to create custom reports based on contacts, gifts, interactions, and other donor data. You can configure the metrics, filters, and breakdowns for a custom report.
kb/guide/en/what-is-a-report-qMv8tGST5Y/:
What is a Report?
A report in DonorDock is an analysis of your donor data that helps you understand your donors and measure the success of your fundraising efforts.
kb/guide/en/report-builder-interface-7JV:
Report Builder Interface
The Report Builder in DonorDock allows you to create custom reports. Learn more about the Report Builder interface and how to navigate it.
kb/guide/en/what-are-donor-segments-WH3l:
What are Donor Segments?
Donor segments in DonorDock are lists of contacts that have been grouped together based on specific criteria. Segments help you organize your donors into meaningful groups for analysis and outreach.
kb/guide/en/save-a-report-1HPwLPXoVF/Ste:
Save a Report
After creating a report in DonorDock, you can save it for future reference and analysis.
kb/guide/en/email-settings-bLWl8MXYvr/St:
Email Settings
DonorDock allows you to set up email and email collection settings.
kb/guide/en/add-contact-notes-to-a-conta:
Add Contact Notes to a Contact
Contact Notes allow you to add detailed information about interactions or conversations with a specific contact.
kb/guide/en/what-are-fields-in-donordock:
What are Fields in DonorDock?
A field in DonorDock is a component used to collect and store data about your contacts. Different field types exist, each serving a specific purpose.
kb/guide/en/how-to-search-for-contacts-i:
How to Search for Contacts in DonorDock
DonorDock allows you to search for contacts in a number of different ways. This guide covers the different search options available.
kb/guide/en/create-a-gift-import-v0J4OGL:
Create a Gift Import
Gift imports allow you to bulk import gift data into DonorDock. You can use a gift import when you want to bring in many gifts at once from an external source.
kb/guide/en/interaction-types-and-custom:
Interaction Types and Custom Interaction Types
Interaction Types help organize your interactions. DonorDock provides a set of default Interaction Types, and you can also create custom Interaction Types.
kb/guide/en/duplicate-contacts-how-to-id:
Duplicate Contacts: How to Identify, Merge, or Delete
Duplicate contacts can occur in DonorDock. This guide explains how to identify, merge, or delete duplicate contacts.
kb/guide/en/setting-up-major-donor-segme:
Setting Up Major Donor Segments
Major Donor segments help you identify your most valuable donors. You can use DonorDock’s built-in major donor segment or create a custom major donor segment.
kb/guide/en/create-custom-segment-a8CpSp:
Create a Custom Segment
You can create custom segments in DonorDock to group contacts based on specific criteria that are relevant to your organization.
kb/guide/en/household-member-assignment-:
Household Member Assignment
When you assign a contact to a household, they become a household member. Household members are contacts that are linked together as part of the same unit.
kb/guide/en/create-a-household-m5C70CNYY:
Create a Household
You can create a household in DonorDock to link multiple contacts together. Households provide a way to manage relationships between different family members or organizational representatives.
kb/guide/en/connect-with-zapier-kv28RGQK:
Connect with Zapier
DonorDock + Zapier integrations allow you to connect DonorDock with thousands of apps without writing code.
kb/guide/en/bulk-delete-contacts-sZqGFhf:
Bulk Delete Contacts
You can bulk delete contacts in DonorDock using the filter and bulk delete features.
kb/guide/en/what-is-a-household-5oQQrqKN:
What is a Household?
A household is a collection of contacts that are linked together to represent a family or organizational unit. Households allow you to track relationships and giving at the household level.
kb/guide/en/delete-a-designation-5XgB8fg:
Delete a Designation
You can delete a designation in DonorDock if it is no longer needed.
kb/guide/en/edit-a-designation-5XgB8fgDk:
Edit a Designation
You can edit a designation in DonorDock to update its name or add more details.
kb/guide/en/what-is-a-gift-6E85JdTU9o/St:
What is a Gift?
A gift in DonorDock is a donation or contribution made by a contact or household. Gifts are central to tracking donor relationships and measuring fundraising success.
kb/guide/en/contact-fields-overview-UhcL:
Contact Fields Overview
Contact Fields are used to store contact information about an individual or organization in DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/create-a-group-import-bnpLVL:
Create a Group Import
Group imports allow you to bulk import group/organizational contact data into DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/how-to-bulk-edit-contacts-iV:
How to Bulk Edit Contacts
DonorDock allows you to bulk edit contacts using the bulk edit feature. This feature allows you to update multiple contacts at once.
kb/guide/en/what-is-a-segment-a8CpSpCSmK:
What is a Segment?
Segments are groups of contacts in DonorDock that share specific characteristics or behaviors. Using segments can help you understand your donor base and target your fundraising efforts.
kb/guide/en/api-guides-rest-endpoint-err:

This guide explains the error codes that DonorDock uses in its REST API, and how to handle them appropriately in your application.
kb/guide/en/api-token-authentication-8I8:
API Token Authentication
DonorDock uses API tokens for authentication. This guide explains how to generate and use API tokens.
kb/guide/en/set-up-the-stripe-integratio:
Set up the Stripe Integration
You can connect DonorDock to Stripe to automatically import gift data into DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/what-is-donordock-xKm3j7PeVg:
What is DonorDock?
DonorDock is a cloud-based donor management system that helps nonprofits build stronger relationships with their donors. DonorDock makes it easy to track, analyze, and engage with your donors.
kb/guide/en/setup-a-connection-to-stripe:
Setup a Connection to Stripe
Before you can import gifts from Stripe into DonorDock, you must first set up a connection to your Stripe account.
kb/guide/en/bulk-import-interactions-7R3:
Bulk Import Interactions
Interaction imports allow you to bulk import interaction data into DonorDock. You can import interactions from an external source such as a spreadsheet.
kb/guide/en/setup-guide-for-your-organiz:
Setup Guide for Your Organization
Focus on the steps that are relevant to your organization’s use of DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/find-an-interaction-by-numbe:
Find an Interaction by Number
You can search for interactions by their interaction numbers or IDs in DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/automations-overview-gQBDAlN:
Automations Overview
Automations in DonorDock help you save time by automating repetitive tasks. Learn about different types of automations and how they can help your organization.
kb/guide/en/delete-a-gift-sKVYqVSQ3u/Ste:
Delete a Gift
You can delete a gift in DonorDock if it was created by mistake or needs to be removed from your records.
kb/guide/en/find-and-sort-gifts-7Vf3mS7l:
Find and Sort Gifts
DonorDock allows you to find and sort gifts based on a variety of criteria. You can search for gifts by contact, amount, or date.
kb/guide/en/understanding-your-major-don:
Understanding Your Major Donor List
Your major donor segment in DonorDock provides insights into your most valuable donors. Understanding your major donor list helps you focus your cultivation and stewardship efforts.
kb/guide/en/custom-fields-overview-5ugL9:
Custom Fields Overview
Custom Fields allow you to capture and store data in DonorDock that isn’t available in the standard contact fields.
kb/guide/en/what-is-the-activity-log-vEf:
What is the Activity Log?
The Activity Log in DonorDock displays a record of all actions taken on a contact, including gifts, interactions, and field updates.
kb/guide/en/the-donordock-approach-to-re:
The DonorDock Approach to Reporting
DonorDock provides various reporting capabilities that allow you to analyze your donor data and measure your fundraising success.
kb/guide/en/set-up-your-organization-inf:
Set up Your Organization Information
You can set up and manage your organization's information in DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/send-contribution-statements:
Send Contribution Statements
Once you’ve set up Contribution Statements in DonorDock, you can send them to your donors.
kb/guide/en/create-custom-interaction-ty:
Create Custom Interaction Types
You can create custom Interaction Types in DonorDock that match your organization’s needs.
kb/guide/en/request-a-feature-Zl2F9yrHVT:
Request a Feature
Have an idea about a feature you’d like to see in DonorDock? We’d love to hear your feedback!
kb/guide/en/what-is-a-designation-8ycJ3v:
What is a Designation?
Designations in DonorDock are categories that help you organize and track gifts based on where the money is directed.
kb/guide/en/api-guides-update-queries-KL:
API Guides: Update Queries
This guide explains how to use update queries with DonorDock’s API. Update queries allow you to modify contact data in DonorDock using the API.
kb/guide/en/viewing-contact-information-:
Viewing Contact Information for Organizations
Organization contacts in DonorDock include information specific to the organization.
kb/guide/en/api-guides-query-filters-KL3:
API Guides: Query Filters
This guide explains how to use query filters with DonorDock’s API. Query filters allow you to retrieve specific contact data from DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/contact-information-for-indi:
Contact Information for Individuals
Individual contacts in DonorDock include information specific to an individual person.
kb/guide/en/api-guides-read-only-queries:
API Guides: Read-Only Queries
This guide explains how to perform read-only queries with DonorDock’s API. Read-only queries allow you to retrieve contact data from DonorDock.
kb/guide/en/manage-users-and-permissions:
Manage Users and Permissions
You can manage your DonorDock users and set permissions for different user roles.
kb/guide/en/what-are-automations-gQBDAlN:
What are Automations?
Automations are workflows in DonorDock that automatically perform actions based on specific conditions. Learn about the different types of automations and how they can help your organization.
kb/guide/en/automation-workflow-builder-:
Automation Workflow Builder
The Automation Workflow Builder in DonorDock allows you to create custom automations.
kb/guide/en/create-a-copy-of-an-automati:
Create a copy of an Automation
After an Automation has been created, you can make a duplicate copy of the Automation, if desired, as a starting point for another Automation.
kb/guide/en/create-a-new-automation-gQBD:
Create a New Automation
To create a new automation, you may either copy an existing Automaton or build a new Automation from scratch.
